Name: Em's Rabbits
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Fourteen colour options for the rabbits. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
Including the rabbit, baby rabbit and Marnie's livestock shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Palomino (blonde)
Rex (red)
English (white with brown spots)
Alaska (black and grey)
Beveren (white)
Tan (black and brown)
Dutch (black and white)
Lop (long ear)
Angora (fluffy)
German (grey longhair)
Lion (long hair)
Pearl (grey)
Harlequin (black and brown)
California (white and black nose)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Rabbits CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a rabbit from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the 14 options
If you rather choose which colour you buy, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]

Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Rabbits CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a [i]config.json[/i]

The default is the Palomino Rabbit. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] in the rabbit mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Palomino[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's shop icon
Save and close the file again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]
